locations.name: Containment Mezzanine
locations.atmosphere: Dust hangs motionless in the air, refusing to settle, as if time here has stopped.
hazards: residual temporal discharge (sanity drains near the walls)
unstable lighting — the dark comes without warning

hazards: biohazard mist (health drain without a filter)
the Ancient One patrols this ring every few minutes

dialogue: "Don't trust the version of me that's kind. I've never been kind."
"It wears faces. If you see someone you lost — run."
"Day 52. The lights went out at 3:04 and never came back properly."
"If you hear your own voice calling from the vents, do not answer it."
alienBehavior: K'Thaal update: patrols in counter-clockwise loops, faster after each kill.
storyBranch: A power fluctuation reveals a corridor that isn't on any map. It smells of your childhood home.
